# PREFACE.

I shall now conclude, and in all true fervor of the Spirit and Love, call upon the Holy Spirit, that this entire matter and substance which I have brought forth here, may be essentially perceived and worked out. My intention was that some preceding <term>openings<note>In mystical traditions, an "opening" refers to a direct spiritual insight or revelation from God that "opens" the understanding of the believer.</note></term> and revelations which I had received should have seen the Light first: But the Wisdom and the Counsel of the **Most High** has changed that which I had thus intended, and has commanded this to go before, as a **Preparation** for the other, which in time shall also be published, to discover even more wonderful and hidden things; which until now have lain as if sealed, under a seal which shall now be broken open; for the time of ripeness approaches, which shall be ready [and fit] for their reception.

13. ## The INTRODUCTION and TREATISE

->Toward and Concerning<-

# SPIRITUAL DYING.

<margin>1.</margin>
The Spirit of Wisdom, Revelation, and Prophecy, which has been abundantly poured out everywhere to proclaim many great and wonderful mysteries now in this last Age; that same Spirit has also shown us how one can reach their completion and fulfillment. The first and nearest way to this is through the mystical <gloss>or spiritual</gloss> death; which one must pass through as the path <gloss>leading</gloss> to the high Mountain of the <gloss>consequent</gloss> Glory <note>The author presents "mystical death"—the process of surrendering the ego and worldly desires—not as an end, but as the necessary doorway to spiritual transformation.</note>.

<margin>2.</margin>
But before I proceed further in this, it will be necessary to make you understand what has caused me to place this crucified Body of Sin <note>original: "Lichaem der Sonden"; a biblical reference to Romans 6:6, referring to the human inclination toward sin that must be "crucified" with Christ.</note> so clearly before your eyes: Namely, the deep feeling that opened within me concerning the threefold slavery and imprisonment under which the Holy and Royal Offspring of God groans, as much in Spirit and Soul as in Body.

<meta>catchword: Which</meta>

<summary>This page introduces the concept of "Spiritual Dying" as the essential path to reaching divine mysteries and glory. The author explains that her motivation for writing is a deep awareness of the spiritual and physical "slavery" that holds humanity captive.</summary>
<keywords>Spiritual Dying, Mystical Death, Revelation, Wisdom, Body of Sin, Threefold Slavery, Royal Offspring of God</keywords>

<header>Concerning Spiritual Dying.</header>

<margin>19</margin>
Which things being well known within my own self, I could all the more sensitively lament and weep for them on behalf of all God’s **chosen offspring** <gloss>original: "uytverkooren zaedt"; referring to the elect or the spiritually reborn</gloss>. And truly, the **Spirit of Daniel** <note>A reference to the biblical prophet Daniel, who was known for his mourning and intercessory prayer on behalf of his people (see Daniel 9 and 10).</note> came upon me and powerfully set this in motion and brought it into labor; causing me to frequently and periodically sequester myself to weep and mourn, as I saw under what a **Law of Sin** and Tyrannical servitude the Saints lie in a threefold respect.

3. First, in respect to that **ancient Serpent**, who from the beginning introduced the original poison of Sin, and is still always intent on making it increase and keeping it active; for which he also has great advantage, being a mighty Prince in this world; through which he presents all sorts of temptations to us, to entice us therewith and to hinder the restoration of the soul, keeping it captive under the enchantments of the Spirit of this World.

<margin>Dan. 7: v. 25.</margin>
4. Second, in respect to the **Beast** <note>In the apocalyptic tradition of Daniel and Revelation, "The Beast" represents earthly powers or systems that oppose the divine order.</note> that reigns under him; which beast is like the oppressive Pharaoh, who continually consults how to impose such an overly heavy weight and burden upon the **Saints of the Most High** <note>original: "Heyligen des Alderhoogsten"; those dedicated to God who suffer under worldly or spiritual oppression.</note> that they might succumb and perish under it.

5. Third, in respect to the **Realm of the Air**, of which he is also said to be a Prince [Ephesians 2:2], having contaminated it with poisonous influences, to such an extent that even the outward Elements—

But the **Almighty God** rose up within me / as a **Fiery Flaming Wall**; driving back that tossing **Sea of the Senses** / and of the spirits that stormed and attacked me / shutting them out / and laying the same in **Bonds** / outside of His own **Risen Body**.

# An Epistle or Preface

# INTRODUCTION.

My intention was / that I would for now have suspended the further disclosure of the Revelation / which continually pursued me; and I would have hidden this golden Talent <term>Talent: A reference to the Parable of the Talents in Matthew 25; here it signifies a spiritual gift or divine insight that the recipient is obligated to share rather than bury.</term> / so that it might grow in its own invisible ground <note>In the mystical tradition of Jacob Boehme, the "invisible ground" or *Ungrund* refers to the divine essence from which all creation and spiritual insight emerge.</note> / from whence it first unfolded itself / until the time / that it came to break forth in the multiplying number of the Holy Spirit / to seal the Glory of all that has preceded in Vision and Prophecy: But *Christ* the shining Banner of Glory stood before me / and said: Remember the Journal <term>Journal: Original "Dag-boeck." This likely refers to Jane Leade's "A Spiritual Diary," where she recorded her daily visions and communications with the divine.</term> of the newly Risen Life / according to the calling in which you are placed; and know / that what has been revealed / and shall be further revealed / shall be sealed with a mighty Testimony / that shall overcome all opposition / wherever the same might arise. Therefore proceed / and do not cease from writing; for it shall be as a clearing of the mists <note>original: "ontnevelinge." Literally an "un-fogging" or dispelling of clouds, signifying the removal of spiritual confusion.</note> of the present dark Day / and many shall come to the radiance of his Resurrection / although the same now seems to be under an eclipse <note>original: "verduyſteringe." Used here to describe a state where divine light is temporarily obscured or hidden from the world's sight.</note>.

21. **After an internal conversation with my Lord concerning the fragile little ship of Nature / which still lies on the foreign coast / and is often in danger / of springing a leak due to certain stormy waves and floods; the Lord immediately entered into me / and revealed Himself with these words /** Reflect well upon my Grace and Love, and consider that the same has been so great, that I have sunk my Life so deep into yours, that you can suffer nothing, or I call it my own. Your broken little ship shall be renewed in its original form, when all the sinful qualities <note>original: "Eygenschappen." In this context, it refers to the inherent characteristics or "drives" of the fallen human nature.</note> shall be drowned in the **ALPHA and OMEGA**, who is the Beginning and the End of time; and who shall open the sealed Gold Mine, where the unsearchable wealth shall be free and overflowing, as in the State of Innocence <note>original: "Staet der Onnoselheyt." This refers to the prelapsarian state of Adam—the purity of humanity before the Fall.</note>, where no need or want was known: All of this has already begun and increases in the moving Circle of the Godhead: All that is required of you, is that you remain constantly in the highest flowing drive and progress of Faith.

22. **My Spirit was lowered into the deep Center and the circumference / where the Personal Glory met me / and gave me that great happiness of beholding the Shepherd with his flock there / which—**

## The First Property.

25. The first Property was a circulating Cloud of Light / from which a continuous Revelation would arise / opening that which was never known before / namely, the Invisible Displays of Glory / which are entirely strange and unknown to the Mortal Man / because he does not understand his original royal state. But wherever Christ / the Central Light, has entered into the Essence <term>Essence: The Dutch "Weezendhept" refers to the fundamental substance or inner being of the soul, rather than just its outward character.</term> of the Soul / there the everlasting Light breaks forth / showing the invisible things in their first pure Ground <term>Ground: In mystical thought, the "Ground" (Grond) is the deepest, most foundational part of the soul where the human meets the divine.</term> / where the eternal Fire-Soul <note>original: "Vuer-Ziele." A term used in Jacob Boehme’s theosophy to describe the soul's energetic, longing nature that must be tempered by the Light of Christ.</note> moves strongly to emerge from a powerless, weak life / which has been locked up in this despised Body of Sin: the Light of Revelation makes the soul restless to remain therein any longer / causing it to strive for another Principle out of a new rising Ground and Wellspring / flowing forth from the Godhead / which imparts powers of strength for a deified activity / and can give a living Testimony / that a new sprout appears from an old Tree / whose Sap is renewed / in order to bring forth the second Property of the Holy Spirit / as another Fruit-bearing Branch.

### The Second Property.

26. This Branch is brought forth from the all-encompassing Element / in which the Soul is baptized as if in a Cloud of Fire. All those who come to know this Baptism need no greater testimony / as far as concerns themselves / for they know that their Dwelling is in the Center of the Heart of God; they are fed and sustained by the Blood of Life / and the Oil-Lamp which makes the whole Body within like a burning Cherub <note>original: "Cherub." In mystical literature, a celestial being associated with wisdom and light; here used to describe the illuminated internal state of the believer.</note> / which at times and on occasions can climb and fly up into the Heavens. Though this is as yet a hidden, dark matter / and little experienced / yet know that the time of Elijah <note>Elijah is often invoked in mystical traditions as a herald of a new age of spiritual restoration and the "internal" return of Christ.</note> is near / and that a Whirlwind from the Alpha and Omega <note>original: "Alpha en Omega." The first and last letters of the Greek alphabet, representing Christ as the beginning and the end (Revelation 22:13).</note> shall come down / to take up the slain Witnesses / who in this world have been so little esteemed and valued.

27. The Gate of Ascension is unlocked by this Shining Key / to enter into Heaven / which was taken away from among Men / so that He was no more / but was hidden in the Mystery <term>Mystery: The Dutch "Myſterium" here refers to the hidden, divine realm or the secret workings of God's providence.</term>. And so shall it be again / though in another form and shape; for although these Elijah-Prophets shall be freed from all that is of the degenerate Nature / they shall nevertheless differ from Elijah; for where He was taken up / and was no longer seen among Men / so shall these, on the contrary, in their visible Persons

## The Third Property.

28. The third emanating Property of the Holy Spirit / which leads into the Kingdom of Christ <note>original: "Rijcke Christi."</note> / is this: that a soul made simple and naked / emerging from the baptizing Cloud / puts on a Garment of invincible resistance and power / namely a pure **Magical Body**, such as the Lord Christ had after his **Resurrection** / consisting of the pure **One-Element** <term>One-Element: Also known as the "Pure Element" or "Quintessence" in mystical philosophy; it is a spiritual, incorruptible substance that exists behind the four visible elements of nature.</term> / which can consume the visible, coarse substance of the flesh / so that the flesh is no longer an obstacle for the Soul / in running her Course / and indeed such a Body is fitting / and is prepared for such great things / as must be accomplished on Earth by the **Anointed Kings**: For if Christ had not provided them with such a Body / it would be in vain / that He wished to begin to establish his Kingdom / where the **Beast** and the **Dragon** have held their dominion for so long / and will now not be so easily deposed from their **Throne** / for they wish to keep their property within the outward shell of the body / when they can no longer find a place for themselves in the Soul.

29. **Therefore** the **Lord** has revealed that he will transform the **Body itself** / back into its **Paradisiacal** **Property** / oh, so that the **Prince** of **Darkness** / and his **Servants** would be unable / to overwhelm the **Lord’s** **Personal Kingdom** in his **Saints** / who would see no more desirable **Target** / upon which to shoot their **Arrows** / than a brittle, mortal, and fleshly **Body**. **Therefore** the **Lord** has said / that he will erect a firm **Tabernacle** <note>In this mystical context, the "Tabernacle" refers to a spiritualized, resurrected body that acts as a dwelling place for God, echoing the biblical Tabernacle in the wilderness.</note> / which no **Earthly-Weapon-arrows** shall be able to pierce / and this shall be a suitable garment / to be able to endure the **thousand** **Years**: Let the **Righteous** and **Holy** believe this / and let them see to it that everything is first completed / in the **Kingdom** that is in the **Essence** of the **Soul** / and then they shall be allowed to conclude and expect / that they shall receive visible powers / to rule with **Christ** in a **Magical** <term>Magical: In 17th-century mystical philosophy, "Magical" (magische) refers to the direct power of the spirit over matter, or the "will-spirit" acting through divine harmony, rather than occult sorcery.</term> power over all **Kingdoms** of this **World**.

### The Fourth Property.

30. **The** fourth emanating power of the **Holy Spirit** / sets the **Soul** free / in an eternal freedom / from all strife that the **Dragon** or the **Star-realm** <note>original: "Sterrenrijk." This imagery of a sun that never sets refers to the divine light of the New Jerusalem.</note>

<meta>This page serves as a concluding afterword (Post-Scriptum) to the "Revelation of Revelations," following the formal ending on page 248. It transitions from the main theological discourse to a personal address in verse from the translator or editor to the literary community.</meta>

<page-num>249</page-num>
<header>POSTSCRIPT <note>original: "POST-SCRIPTUM"</note></header>
<sig>Q 5</sig>
<meta>catchword: NOTE (original: "NOTA")</meta>

Here is the Postscript with the Errata <note>original: "Errata," referring to a list of printing errors to be corrected</note>, for the Estates of Literature, presented here in rhyme and meter:
But though my Poetry <note>original: "Poësi"</note> has its beauties,
Know however that the Soul does not live in such things;
But aims for holiness. You are mistaken if you expect 
Ways of speaking here that worldly people praise:
The Author <note>The text uses the feminine "haar" (her), referring to Jane Lead.</note> leaves her desire behind and strives through Heaven’s Cloud,
While you burn for Art, and for praise among the People,
While the Heart burns with thirst. Alas! sharp wits <note>original: "scherpen vonden," referring to intellectual cleverness or academic ingenuity</note>
Prevent you from fathoming God’s <term>MAGIC<gloss>original: "MAGIA." In the context of 17th-century mysticism, this refers to the divine, creative power of God rather than sorcery.</gloss></term>:
But if that were known to you! If it were known! Oh, then
You would—even if you were a wise and virtuous Man—
Go infinitely higher! The Author must expect such powers,
And Heavenly Art from God's benevolence;
Where there are Soul-visions and Revelations
With which the Muses <note>The nine Greek goddesses of inspiration in the arts and sciences.</note> also unite themselves,
But the graces of show, or poetic charms,
Do not deserve to have one's fine zeal spent upon them.
One is invited here to turn the eye inward.
I pray, I pray you, choose to walk on Heavenly paths.

->Your simple, sincere, and true-hearted<-
->Friend and Servant<-

->E H. M A M P.<-

Since it was intended in *The Revelation of Revelations* to place the subjects being discussed distinctly at the top, just as was done in *The Heavenly Cloud*, let the Reader please take note that the Paragraphs or Verses begin anew four times.

The first, which are 67 in number, begin on p. 23 and end on p. 71; in these you will find an Introduction on how the Author was moved and urged to Write, etc., from p. 23 to 33. The Vision of the New Jerusalem, etc., p. 34. The Opening of the Seven Seals, p. 47. And of the Seven Thunders, p. 62. With a concluding Verse, p. 69.

The second, which are 92 in number, begin on p. 71 and end on p. 133; in these are treated the Thousand-Year Kingdom <note>The "Millennium," a prophesied era of peace and holiness on Earth.</note> with several circumstances, p. 71. Twelve Gates, which lead to the New Jerusalem, p. 113. And what Powers and Wonders shall follow thereafter, p. 127. With a Verse referring to this.
